I added a 0.25-second sleep after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`. I haven't run the test, so I haven't confirmed this fixes the CI flake.

- **Change:** the loop now calls `time.sleep(SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL_S)` after each request. The new constant is set to 0.25 seconds, with a comment explaining the 5 requests/second limit.
- **Why 0.25s:** the limit allows one request every 0.2 seconds, so 0.25 leaves some headroom. It adds about 1 second to the test.

If more tests start calling the sandbox, a shared rate-limiting fixture or a retry on HTTP 429 would be sturdier than sleeps in each test.

I also saved the 5 requests/second limit as a note in the project's memory store, so later sessions will know about it.
